C0844.title: New Phishing Kit InboxPrime AI Features Built-in AI Email Generator for Automated Attacks
C0844.summary: In December 2025, cybersecurity researchers identified the phishing kit InboxPrime AI, which features a built-in AI email generator capable of producing complete phishing emails—including subject lines—that mimic legitimate business correspondence.
